title: 第023章 神圣圣堂第024章 神圣秩序凯莎
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 苏业看了看自己手中的资源，预估了一下直接回了消息。
【异界旅人：什么兵营，价格多少？】
林小小这边，看着苏业的回话眼前一亮，这次的兵营不是她收购来的，而是有人放在她这里寄卖的。
林小小目前认识有能力购买或者说置换兵营的人是谁，只有苏业了，所以才会来询问一句，并没有太大的期待。
【小小商人：这是别人放在我这里寄卖的，兵营是三阶兵营：十字修女，秩序阵营兵种，也算是比较强力的兵种了，他的要求是，同样的三阶兵营混乱阵营的或者说一些有长远价值的图纸，秘宝，奇观都可以。】
苏业看着小小商人发来的消息，三阶兵营换取图纸，秘宝，奇观吗？
“狮子大开口啊。”苏业揉了揉眉心看着发来的消息。
三阶兵营说到底也就那样，十字修女虽然算是强力的兵种，但是终究是三阶的兵营，其价值远远不值紫色图纸。
哪怕是一般的青色等级的图纸都不值。
至于原因是多方面的，一方面他能拿出来卖，就说明他用不了，第二个青色等级的图纸就是源源不断的金矿，价值远高于三阶兵营。
更别说秘宝，奇观了，这特么的纯粹就是在狮子大开口。
三阶兵营就是三阶兵营，没有进化兵营的能力，这玩意说破天了也就是普通的兵种而已。
不管是图纸，还是秘宝，奇观都是属于长远收益大于三阶兵营的，这也是共识。
【异界旅人：价格太高了，没有图纸，也没有秘宝，更没有奇观。】
林小小看着苏业回复的消息，眼前一亮，虽然苏业说没有图纸，没有秘宝，更没有奇观，但是说明苏业手里还有其他的东西。
【小小商人：大佬买卖的事情，都是讨价还价的，你能出到什么价位？我去帮你谈。】
苏业看着林小小发来的消息想了想随后回复到。
【异界旅人：五张高级肉类资源卡，1000本源结晶。】
林小小看着苏业发来的消息两眼放光，五张高级肉类资源卡，市场价一张就是100本源结晶，在加上1000本源结晶。
这个时候，这个价格真不低了。
【小小商人：大佬等等，我去帮你问一下，等我。】
苏业深吸了一口气，虽然自己很想要这个兵营，但是能够讨价还价，不代表自己就一定要当冤大头。
苏业直接盘坐在大厅之中，等待着林小小的消息。
过了一会，林小小的消息回复了过来。
【小小商人：大佬对方说，太少了，你在加点。】
看着小小商人发来的消息，苏业脸上露出笑容，有得谈就行。
【异界旅人：他要多少？】
【小小商人：他的意思是高级资源卡十张，本源结晶2000，这是他的底线了，再低就算了。】
苏业看着小小商人发来的消息，算了算，不算太贵，换算起来也就三千本源结晶，也就是在新手期才能捡到这种东西了。
【异界旅人：可以，交易吧。】
【小小商人：好的大佬，申请交易了。】
苏业直接将两千本源结晶外加十张高级肉类资源卡交易到了一座三阶的兵营：修女教堂！
一座白色的教堂模型出现在了苏业的手中，哥特式的穹顶，白色的十字架，绽放着神圣的光辉。
“升级！”苏业看着自己手中的教堂模型。
content_en:
Su ye looked at the resources in his hands, made an estimate and replied directly.
[Traveler from another world: What kind of military camp and how much does it cost? 】
Lin Xiaoxiao's eyes lit up when she saw Su Ye's reply. She didn't buy the barracks this time, but someone put them on consignment for her.
Lin Xiaoxiao currently knew only Su Ye who had the ability to purchase or replace the barracks, so he came to ask without much expectation.
[Little businessman: This is what someone else put on consignment for me. The barracks are the third-level barracks: Sisters of the Cross, a unit of the order camp, which is also a relatively powerful unit. His request is that the same third-level barracks of the chaos camp, or some blueprints, secret treasures, and wonders with long-term value are acceptable. 】
Su Ye looked at the message from the small businessman, asking for blueprints, secret treasures, and wonders in exchange for the third-level barracks?
"The lion opens his mouth." Su ye rubbed his eyebrows and looked at the message.
In the final analysis, the third-level barracks is just that. Although the Cross Sisters are considered a powerful unit, they are still third-level barracks, and their value is far less than the purple blueprint.
Even ordinary cyan grade drawings are not worth it.
As for the reasons, there are many reasons. On the one hand, if he can sell them, it means that he can't use them. The second cyan level blueprint is a steady stream of gold mines, and its value is much higher than that of the third-level barracks.
Not to mention the secret treasures and wonders, this is just the lion's mouth.
The third-level barracks is just a third-level barracks. It does not have the ability to evolve the barracks. This thing is just an ordinary unit.
Whether it's a blueprint or a secret treasure, the long-term benefits of wonders are greater than those of Tier 3 barracks. This is also a consensus.
[Traveler from another world: The price is too high, there are no blueprints, no secret treasures, and no wonders. 】
Lin Xiaoxiao's eyes lit up when he saw Su Ye's reply. Although Su Ye said that there were no blueprints, no secret treasures, and no wonders, it meant that Su Ye had other things in his hands.
[Small businessman: The big boss’s business is all about bargaining. What price can you offer? I'll go talk to you. 】
Su ye looked at the message sent by Lin Xiaoxiao, thought about it and then replied.
[Traveler from another world: five high-grade meat resource cards, 1000 source crystals. 】
Lin Xiaoxiao's eyes lit up when he saw the message from Su Ye. There were five high-end meat resource cards. The market price was 100 Origin Crystals each, plus 1,000 Origin Crystals.
At this time, the price is really not low.
[Little businessman: Boss, wait a minute. I’ll go ask for you. Wait for me. 】
Su Ye took a deep breath. Although he wanted this barracks very much, being able to bargain didn't mean he had to be taken advantage of.
Su ye sat cross-legged in the hall, waiting for news from Lin Xiaoxiao.
After a while, Lin Xiaoxiao's message came back.
[Small businessman: The big boss said to me, it’s too little, so you need to add more. 】
Seeing the message from the small businessman, Su ye had a smile on his face. Just talk if you want.
[Traveler from another world: How much does he want? 】
[Little businessman: What he means is ten high-end resource cards and 2000 source crystals. This is his bottom line. No matter how low it is, it will be lower. 】
Su ye looked at the message from the small businessman and calculated that it was not too expensive. In total, it only cost three thousand origin crystals. This kind of thing could only be picked up in the novice stage.
[Traveler from another world: Okay, let’s trade. 】
[Little businessman: Okay, big boss, I’ve applied for the transaction. 】
Su ye directly traded two thousand origin crystals and ten high-end meat resource cards to a third-level barracks: the nuns' church!
A white church model appeared in Su ye's hands, with a Gothic dome and a white cross, blooming with divine brilliance.
"Upgrade!" Su ye looked at the church model in his hand.
